name: Stratagem
body:
Tacticians learn new techniques and ways of aiding allies in times of need, as well as strategies they can use against the enemy. At 1st level and every odd levels thereafter, the tactician gains a new Stratagem. Unless specifically noted, the tactician cannot select a stratagem more than once.

Advantageous Strike
Prerequisites: Tactician 5th level
Description: Gain a +4 bonus to hit against opponents suffering from a status effect. This bonus does not increase with multiple status effects or status effects of increasing severity.

Art of Brutality
Prerequisites: None
Description: The tactician makes an especially savage display with his weapon in hand. Upon killing an enemy they can make an intimidate check as a free action, using their Intelligence in place of Charisma on this check.

Art of Protection
Prerequisites: None
Description: As a swift action the tactician can grant one ally within 5 ft. a +1 competence bonus to AC. This lasts for a number of rounds equal to the tactician’s intelligence modifier.

Art of Society
Prerequisites: None
Description: The tactician can make the Diplomacy of themselves or an ally more beneficial and increase the attitude of the target by two steps as opposed to one step. This can only be used once per day.

Art of Survival
Prerequisites: Tactician 9th level
Description: A number of times per day equal to their Intelligence modifier the tactician can roll a fortitude save to not fall unconscious when brought below 0 hit points and automatically stabilize. Their hit points do not lower beyond -1 even if the damage would kill him. The DC of this save is equal to 15 + total damage dealt with the attack.

Calculated Strike
Prerequisites: None
Description: As a swift action, the Tactician can grant one ally within 5 ft. of him an insight bonus to damage rolls equal to his Intelligence modifier. This lasts for 3 rounds.

Coordinated Stealth
Prerequisites: Stealth 5 ranks
Description: Allies within 30 feet of the tactician while benefitting from Coordination can use the Coordination bonus on their Stealth, and so long as one ally is benefitting from concealment their allies are as well.

Demand Respect
Prerequisites: Young Character
Description: A number of times per day equal to their Intelligence modifier, they can garner the attention of all adults in a 30 ft. radius, who will respond with concern, granting a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks when speaking to them. If the character reaches adulthood and still has this Stratagem, they can swap it out for another Stratagem.

Fighter Training
Prerequisites: Tactician 11th level
Description: Gain a bonus combat feat, using half the tactician’s level as their fighter level for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

Gleam of Brilliance
Prerequisites: Tactician 9th level, Combat Expertise
Description: The tactician can sacrifice a number of HP equal to his Constitution score to gain a bonus to damage equal to half of what was sacrificed. Additionally, they may sacrifice AC for bonuses to hit (maximum of -8 AC for a +8 to hit).

Guided by the Gods
Prerequisites: Must worship a deity, can only be selected at 1st level
Description: All insight bonuses become sacred (if the tactician is good) or profane (if the tactician is evil). If the Tactician is neutral, choose one.

Guided Strike
Prerequisites: None
Description: Grant an adjacent ally a +2 bonus to attack rolls against a single enemy. This expends the Tactician’s attack of opportunity, and is thus an immediate action.

Improved Overcharge
Prerequisites: Tactician 15th level, Overcharge Bonus
Description: Increase the effect of Overcharge Bonus to a +4 instead of a +2.

Indignation
Prerequisites: Intimidate 5 ranks, Tactician 5th level
Description: As a standard action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, the Tactician may make a single Intimidate attempt against an opponent. If successful, the opponent becomes flat-footed for 1 round instead of shaken. This cannot be combined with other feats that alter the effects of an Intimidate check.

Intelligent Scrapper
Prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, Tactician 5th level.
Description: The tactician’s unarmed strikes deal damage as a monk 4 levels lower than their Tactician level (minimum 1st level).

Intelligent Wordplay
Prerequisites: None
Description: A number of times per day equal to their Intelligence modifier, the Tactician can add their Intelligence modifier as a bonus to one Charisma-based skill check.

No Language Barrier
Prerequisites: Linguistics 5 ranks
Description: Once per day as a free action, the Tactician can learn to read, write, speak, and understand a language not already on his known language list. This lasts 1 hour per intelligence modifier. This cannot be used to learn Druidic or other secret languages forbidden by the GM.

Overcharge Bonus
Prerequisites: Tactician 13th level.
Description: As a full-round action, the Tactician can ‘overcharge’ one worn magic item that provides a bonus to an ability score. The item’s bonus increases by +2 for a number of rounds equal to half the Tactician’s level. Once the duration ends, the item’s magical properties are suppressed for the Tactician for 1 hour.

Painstaking Effort
Prerequisites: Int 15, Craft (any) 5 ranks
Description: The Tactician reduces the DC to craft a masterwork item by 5.

Pinpoint Targeting
Prerequisites: Int 15, Point Blank Shot
Description: When gaining the benefits of the Point Blank Shot feat against an opponent, the tactician adds their Intelligence modifier as a bonus to damage rolls.

Ratfolk Formation
Prerequisites: Ratfolk, Swarming racial ability
Description: If at least one of the ratfolk using the swarming racial trait is a tactician, all ratfolk gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and AC.

Righteous Wordplay
Prerequisites: Int 15, levels in a divine spellcasting class
Description: The tactician can use their Intelligence modifier in place of their Wisdom or Charisma modifier (if it is higher) as their spellcasting ability for any divine spellcasting classes they possess.

Sea Fairer
Prerequisites: Tactician 9th level
Description: The tactician gains their Coordination bonus to Profession (Sailor) checks. While in combat on a ship, all insight bonuses they grant are doubled, and they are constantly under the effect of freedom of movement (while on the ship only).

Slashing Finish
Prerequisites: Tactician 17th level
Description: The tactician makes a single attack at his highest base attack bonus against an enemy. If the attack hits, the target takes damage and is knocked prone. If the enemy is still prone on its next turn from this attack, the tactician can use this ability again as a standard action to attempt a coup de grace, forcing the target to make a Fortitude save or die.

Tactician’s Terrain
Prerequisites: None
Description: Select one terrain from the Ranger’s favored terrain list. While in this terrain, the tactician receives his Coordination bonus at all times without needing to activate the ability. Only the tactician benefits from this ability.

Trained Ineptitude
Prerequisites: Wisdom 8 or lower
Description: The Tactician can use his Intelligence modifier instead of his Wisdom modifier for the following skills: Perception, Profession, and Sense Motive.

Unnatural Discipline
Prerequisites: Any Knowledge 5 ranks
Description: After successfully identifying a creature with a Knowledge check, the Tactician can, once per day, gain a bonus on damage rolls against that specific creature equal to half his ranks in the Knowledge skill used. This bonus lasts until the enemy is slain or the battle ends.
